snippet.title: Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth - Segment for The MIX Fall 2025
snippet.description:
Are Sundnes from Hyper Games talks a bit about Moomin, Snufkin and our next game, Moomintroll: Winter's Warmth! Get the first glimpse from the game in this nice segment aired at @MediaIndieExchange The Mix Fall Showcase 2025!


Moomintroll: Winter’s Warmth is a story-driven, cozy puzzle adventure that lets you return to the enchanting Moominvalley! Wishlist it on Steam 💙
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3256150/Moomintroll_Winters_Warmth/
